rule: If the native underpinnings exist, the workload is native; a Linuxulator run where a native path exists is invalid.

paths.how: Mesa RADV + native FreeBSD llama.cpp build

paths.blocker: no FreeBSD arm64 NVIDIA Vulkan ICD (NVIDIA ships FreeBSD x86/x86_64 only); Mesa NVK has no RM-direct (libnvrm) backend yet
no native CUDA driver or runtime on FreeBSD; libnvrm S1 only enumerates
the NVIDIA half of the RPC layer split has no native path (see nvidia-rtx5060ti vulkan)
two servers at once, one per card; the NVIDIA server has no native path (see nvidia-rtx5060ti vulkan)
